Org charts are the real source of boundary decisions

Boundary decisions are made by the org chart, not by the process doc. Information architecture, not process, decides who owns the failure. Cross-team incidents pull the right answer out of the org chart every time.

When a team owns a service end-to-end, they own the failure too. When ownership is split across three teams, the failure falls into the gap. The org chart is the only document that survives contact with reality during an incident.
